---
title: "HTMX.jl"
---

`HTMX.jl` provides a Julia interface for building [HTMX](https://htmx.org)-powered HTML using a hyperscript-like syntax backed by [Cobweb.jl](https://github.com/JuliaWeb/Cobweb.jl).

```{julia}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Setup"
cd(dirname(Base.active_project()))
using HTMX
```

## Basic usage

Use `h.tagname(...)` to create HTML nodes:

```{julia}
h.div(class="container")(
    h.h1("Hello, HTMX!"),
    h.p("This is a paragraph.")
)
```

## Hyperscript syntax

The `@__str` macro (via `_"..."`) lets you embed [Hyperscript](https://hyperscript.org) behavior strings directly in nodes:

```{julia}
h.button(
    _"""on click toggle .hidden on #menu""",
    "Toggle menu"
)
```

## `auto` helper

`auto` converts arbitrary values to HTML fragments. It handles strings, arrays, and `Pair`s (for out-of-band HTMX swaps):

```{julia}
auto("raw html string"; wrap=identity)
```

```{julia}
auto(["<li>one</li>", "<li>two</li>"]; wrap=identity)
```
